rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.0025, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-16 LAMBDA peak refinement. tv_init zeros (iter-15) collapsed hr->0.0 (FBP warm-start essential for TV-GD); revert to fbp. Lambda peak is shallow: 2e-3->0.3552, 3e-3->0.3596 (best), 4e-3->0.3336. ONE knob: tv_lambda 3e-3->2.5e-3 (best config otherwise: gamma=1, 1000it, gd, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, fbp init). HYPOTHESIS: if hr>0.3596 the true peak is between 2e-3 and 3e-3 (near 2.5e-3); if hr<0.3596 the peak is at/above 3e-3 and 0.3596 stands as the plain-TV optimum on breast. Budget: ~868s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
